tv_wonder_ceremony_monthly_tick_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_variable = tv_wonder_ceremony_stage } }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_stage value = 0 }
		set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_quarter_month value = 0 }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage < 8 }
		change_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_quarter_month add = 1 }
		if = {
			limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_quarter_month >= 3 }
			set_variable = { name = tv_wonder_ceremony_quarter_month value = 0 }
			if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 0 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9300 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 1 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9301 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 2 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9302 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 3 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9303 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 4 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9304 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 5 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9305 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 6 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9306 days = 1 }
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { var:tv_wonder_ceremony_stage ?= 7 }
				trigger_event_non_silently = { id = tv_engineering_department.9307 days = 1 }
			}
		}
	}
}

tv_wonder_ceremony_start_stage_4_construction_effect = {
	if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 103 }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple_ritual_annex } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_sky_dome_grand_temple_ritual_annex cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
			}
		}
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = { var:tv_wonder_locked ?= 104 }
		var:tv_wonder_site ?= {
			if = {
				limit = { NOT = { has_building = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_ritual_annex } }
				construct_building = { building_type = building_type:tv_wonder_giant_tower_temple_ritual_annex cost_multiplier = 0 cost_multiplier_reason = "game_concept_event" instant = yes }
			}
